name: What a line asks of me
says: the router reads whether a line asks a question, sets a task or gives a fact as the AMI Meeting Corpus's annotators marked its dialogue act, under ISO 24617-2's general-purpose functions

measures.says: percent of the AMI scenario test partition's Elicit acts (test/oracle/corpus.json) the router reads as a question
percent of its Suggest and Offer acts the router reads as a task
percent of its Inform acts the router reads as a fact (an untimed event counted as one)
